hub.title: OPERATOR HUB
hub.subtitle: Select a protocol or join an active room.
hub.itto_desc: Cooperative game of numbers and empathy! Discuss, give thematic clues and align your cards from 1 to 100 without seeing other players' values.
hub.hanabi_desc: Legendary cooperative fireworks show! You cannot see your own cards: deduce through teammates' clues and mount fireworks before fuses run out.
hub.cah_desc: The politically incorrect party game! Complete black card sentences with your most insane white card combinations and win over the Card Czar.
hub.ludo_desc: The legendary classic board game! Roll the dice, get a 6 to leave the yard, capture opponent pawns and race all 4 tokens to victory against friends or bots.

profile.no_matches: No matches recorded yet. Start a game from the Hub to begin your legacy!

itto.lobby_desc: Required: 2 to 8 players. In this cooperative game, everyone wins or loses together.
itto.write_clue_desc: Think of a clue matching your number on the theme scale from 1 to 100:
itto.table_sorting_desc: Drag and drop cards into ascending order (1 ➔ 100). When satisfied, lock in your vote:
itto.game_over_desc: A card was placed out of ascending order.
itto.no_numbers_rule: Forbidden to use digits or numbers!
itto.sorting_hint: Tip: If any player moves a card on the table, everyone's confirmation will be reset for re-evaluation.
itto.advance_hint: Click to start the next round when everyone has finished reviewing the table

hanabi.lobby_desc: Required: 2 to 5 players. The leader configures the show and everyone clicks "I'm Ready".

classic.name: Classic
classic.subtitle: 5 Colors • 50 Cards • Max 25 Pts
classic.desc: The original Hanabi mode with the 5 classic colors and 5 fireworks.

rainbow_full.name: Full Rainbow
rainbow_full.subtitle: 6 Colors • 60 Cards • Max 30 Pts
rainbow_full.desc: Adds the 6th Multicolor with 10 cards and a 6th independent firework.

rainbow_one.name: Single Rainbow
rainbow_one.subtitle: 6 Colors • 55 Cards • High Stakes
rainbow_one.desc: Adds the 6th color with only 1 copy of each number (1 to 5). Discarding the rainbow is fatal!

rainbow_wild.name: Wild Rainbow
rainbow_wild.subtitle: 6 Colors • 60 Cards • Wild Clues
rainbow_wild.desc: Rainbow cards act as wildcards for any color clue! Builds the 6th firework.

hanabi.modifier_perfect_show_desc: The game does not end on empty deck. The team plays until completing all fireworks or loses if any critical card is discarded!
hanabi.your_turn_desc: Choose a card from your hand below to play/discard, or click the Give Clue button on a teammate.
hanabi.waiting_teammate: Turn of {{name}}. Waiting for teammate's move...
hanabi.my_hand_note: (You cannot see color or number, only noted clues)
hanabi.play_card_tooltip: Try playing this card to the show
hanabi.give_clue_modal_desc: A clue costs 1 blue clue token and must be complete: it will point out all cards matching your choice.
hanabi.give_clue_modal_wild_desc: ✨ Wild Rule: Multicolor cards light up for any chosen color clue!
hanabi.discarded_modal_desc: Beware of lost cards: there is only one copy of 5 and two copies of 2, 3 and 4 (in Single Rainbow there is only one of each).
hanabi.toast_five_bonus_sub: {{user}} played the 5 and recovered 1 blue clue token for the team!
hanabi.toast_explosion: 💥 THE POWDER BLEW UP! Error by {{user}}
hanabi.toast_explosion_sub: Tried playing {{color}} {{number}}, but it didn't fit. Mistakes: {{fuses}}/3!
